collection.title: Maserati Grecale 2022 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Maserati Grecale 2022 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
